title: OpenInfra TV: Bringing the Summit to Asia
description: Archived OpenInfra TV coverage details for the 2020 Virtual Summit, with local-language programs for communities in India, China, Japan and Korea.
body:
Local Hosts. Local Language. Local Timezone.

The global Virtual Summit never sleeps. Wherever you are, wake up and collaborate with the Open Infrastructure community.

 

Register to

  • Watch local coverage from community leaders in China, Korea, Japan, or India including commentary on keynote highlights, do a live Q&A with keynote speakers and session recommendations for you to watch on demand. Tune in to OpenInfra TV Tuesday October 20th, at 8:30am India Standard Time / 10am China Standard Time / 11am Japan Standard Time / 11am Korea Standard Time. 

  • Access the full broadcast of the Summit keynotes on demand

  • Participate in live, ongoing discussions on keynote topics and sessions with local community members

  • Join the global conversation throughout the week on Twitter at #OpenInfraSummit
